WEB-ADMIN-01 #382 deterministic browser transcript (2026-09-21 KST)

Evidence boundaries
-------------------
This is a real headed Chromium run against tests/web_management_browser_fixture.py,
an independent synthetic HTTP fixture. It does not run AgentService, a real Telegram
ingest/delivery path, a model/provider, a connector, or any external effect. The
separate executable Python test
test_synthetic_telegram_request_reaches_web_read_models_without_web_chat covers
the injected Telegram service/read-model path. The browser fixture marks its own
channel as telegram:fixture-owner only so the renderer's provenance projection can
be inspected; it is not evidence of live or service-backed Telegram operation.

Prerequisite and server (terminal 1, repository root)
-----------------------------------------------------
  command -v npx
  python3 tests/web_management_browser_fixture.py --port 18782

Observed server output:
  fixture-only http://127.0.0.1:18782

Browser setup (terminal 2, repository root)
-------------------------------------------
  PWCLI=/Users/jongtaelee/.codex/skills/playwright/scripts/playwright_cli.sh
  bash "$PWCLI" open http://127.0.0.1:18782/#tasks --headed
  bash "$PWCLI" resize 1280 900
  bash "$PWCLI" snapshot

Observed coherent task projection:
  list status: 진행 중
  outcome heading/text: 진행 중 / 새 이벤트를 기다리고 있습니다.
  no terminal result was rendered beside the active status.

Polling refresh, expanded event, and synthetic provenance (A3/A7/A8)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Refs below are from each immediately preceding clean-run snapshot.

  bash "$PWCLI" click e33
  bash "$PWCLI" click e35
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' \
    http://127.0.0.1:18782/control/reset-observation
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' \
    http://127.0.0.1:18782/control/append-event
  sleep 7
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18782/control/counts
  bash "$PWCLI" snapshot
  bash "$PWCLI" click e59
  bash "$PWCLI" snapshot

Observed outputs:
  {"events": 2}
  {"test_requests": 0, "apply_requests": 0, "events": 2, "task_polls": 3}
  - the selected timeline updated from one to two events without reselection;
  - the first event remained expanded and still showed 첫 이벤트 after the
    event-driven rerender and three subsequent polling intervals;
  - status/outcome remained coherently 진행 중; the succeeded event was an
    event state, not a fabricated terminal task result;
  - execution detail rendered 요청 경로 Telegram. This is the explicitly
    synthetic fixture channel described in the evidence boundary above.

Full local record search, focus/caret, and pending-delete preservation (A4/A7)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  bash "$PWCLI" click e10

  bash "$PWCLI" snapshot
  bash "$PWCLI" click e112
  bash "$PWCLI" snapshot

  bash "$PWCLI" press ArrowLeft
  bash "$PWCLI" press ArrowLeft
  bash "$PWCLI" press ArrowLeft
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' \

Observed outputs after four polls:

  {"focused":true,"value":"durable-key","start":8,"end":8}
  snapshot still showed 삭제 확인; no DELETE request occurred.

The full-content search regression also ran in the same browser:

  bash "$PWCLI" click e76

Observed: 로컬 원문 기록 1개를 찾았습니다., and the matching row whose
needle begins after character 300 remained visible. The executable Node regression
also checks both this case and exact durable-memory-key search.

  {"focused":true,"value":"fixture-unsaved-token","start":19,"end":19}

Then reset the request observer, traverse actual browser history, and inspect the
same unsaved field and every application request made during pane/history entry:

  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' \
    http://127.0.0.1:18782/control/reset-observation
  bash "$PWCLI" go-back
  bash "$PWCLI" go-back
  bash "$PWCLI" go-forward
  bash "$PWCLI" go-forward

  bash "$PWCLI" eval \
    'el => JSON.stringify({value:el.value,visible:!el.closest("form").hidden,url:location.hash})' e162
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18782/control/requests

Observed:
  {"value":"fixture-unsaved-token","visible":true,"url":"#settings/external"}
  The request log contained only GET /favicon.ico, /api/tasks, /api/home,
  /api/state, and /api/personal-space entries. It contained no POST, PUT,
  PATCH, or DELETE application request. The reset control request is deliberately
  excluded from the application log. Thus pane entry and history navigation were
  observed read-only, not inferred from source strings.

R5/R6 deterministic behavior and browser request counts
---------------------------------------------------------
The executable Node check in test_source_derived_task_record_and_model_regressions
starts an unresolved old-key test, changes only the credential revision, resolves
the old success, and asserts it is rejected. It then tests the new draft and applies
once, asserting test_requests == 2 and save_requests == 1. This is executable async
behavior, not a string assertion.

In a fresh browser-fixture process, direct interaction also observed:
  - changing only the key disabled apply and displayed 다시 테스트하세요;
  - testing the new key enabled apply;
  - applying once produced /control/counts values test_requests=2 and
    apply_requests=1, proving there was no hidden third test.

No credential in this transcript is real; fixture-unsaved-token is inert text and
was never submitted.
